set.recording.fps.help: 60 fps by default, at a constant frame rate (what DaVinci and Premiere expect).
set.recording.resolution.help: Up to this height, never larger than the picture on screen.
set.recording.auto.help: Starts when you arm, stops 3 s after you disarm, into the last chosen folder.
set.recording.folder.help: Where videos go without asking every time (Chrome and Edge on a computer). Other browsers keep the video and offer the file after the flight.
set.recording.splitMin.help: A long flight is split into files: if the tab crashes, only the last part is lost.
set.recording.authorNotice.help: The first video of a scan outside the showcase shows one line on the recording bar: whose scan it is, its licence, and that the video is yours to use and to credit.
